caseNameFull: Wyman, Commissioner of Social Services of New York v. James
attorneys: Louis J. Lefkowitz, Attorney General of New York, Samuel A. Hirshowitz, First Assistant Attorney General, and Brenda Soloff, Assistant Attorney General, for appellant Wyman. Jonathan Weiss for appellees. Messrs. Lefkowitz and Hirshowitz on the application for stay. Lee A. Albert in opposition to the application.

opinions.text:
Appeal from S. D. N. Y. Motion of appellees for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Probable jurisdiction noted. Application for stay denied.

The Chief Justice and Mr. Justice Black are of the opinion that the stay should be granted.
